title: lepidium montanum var. cinereum
intro: Lepidium montanum var. cinereum, commonly known as Mountain Pepper Cress, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Pepper Cress include its ability to act as a diuretic, reducing urine retention, and its antioxidant properties, which help to protect against cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isothiocyanates and other glucosinolates, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
